create_ReplayBuffer: create a ReplayBuffer with a fixed buffer_size to store experience trajectories for reinforcement learning
store_path_in_ReplayBuffer: store a trajectory path object into the ReplayBuffer using the store method
sample_from_ReplayBuffer: sample n random non-end-state indices from the ReplayBuffer for training batch construction
sample_filtered_ReplayBuffer: sample n indices from a filtered SampleBuffer subset by key using sample_filtered
check_SampleBuffer_consistency: check the internal consistency of a SampleBuffer by verifying idx_to_slot and slot_to_idx mappings
